source_artifacts.description: Session summary describing the strategic shift toward a personal cognitive garden.

accepted_updates.claim: The user wants LS to focus on personal, goal-directed cognitive gardens rather than a generic shared cognitive network.
evidence: The user described each person developing their own cognitive graph.
The user said connected agents and sessions should help cultivate that graph like a garden.
The user connected the idea to human development and commercial value.

review.reason: The owner explicitly confirmed this as the next LS direction.

policy_notes: Accepted as a private durable garden goal.
External actions still require separate authorization.

nodes.label: LS should develop personal goal-directed cognitive gardens
